# `comply-color`

The coloured path a developer actually sees in a terminal. Captured raw, so escape sequences are part of the diff.

## What runs

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | `hermex comply` |
| **Working directory** | `fixtures/` |
| **Config** | [`fixtures/hermex.config.ts`](../hermex.config.ts) |
| **Fixture** | [`fixtures`](..) — [overview](../README.md) |
| **Asserted exit code** | `1` |
| **Environment** | `NO_COLOR` unset, `FORCE_COLOR=3` |
| **Colour** | captured raw, so escape sequences are part of the recorded output |

## Recorded output

Nothing is committed for this case's output — every run compares this tree's real output against a fresh build of the target branch (`--against`, `main` by default). A change to hermex's output shows up as a diff in that run's output-review report, never as a file in this repo.

## Run it locally

```bash

```
